pages.text: In $(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)projectile_item_mappings.json$(), set $(n){"entity":"minecraft:tnt","replace_entity":true}$() to make a weapon actually launch a different entity (e.g. arrows shooting TNT).$(br2)The global $(bold)allow_dangerous_replace$() switch (default false) must also be enabled.

$(2)Details$()$(br)Replacement happens at spawn: original entity canceled, new entity created with position/velocity/rotation/owner transferred. Damage resolves through the mapped entity's distribution, falling back to damage type mappings (TNT explosion -> Blunt).$(br2)$(4)Warning$(): mapping to large entities (Ender Dragon) may misbehave.
